subject: Conditional degree-45641 recovery transfer and same-curve horizontal K-163 control

horizontal_exact_image_order.claim: alpha maps an exact order-r point to an exact order-r point

next_falsifiable_test: After explicit vertical maps exist, run planted scalar round trips on the actual cyclic subgroup and fully charge construction, preprocessing, evaluation, verification, and amortization against native K-163 arithmetic.
